content:
incident-bot: Paging @jess-oncall (oncall) — policy-engine service is reporting repeated runtime panics during rule evaluation. Error spike started 03/15 14:12 UTC, elevated 5xx rates and automatic fallbacks observed. Severity: P1.

jess-oncall: ack I'm on it. seeing 5xx + spike in eu-west-1 latency/timeout traces. can folks avoid mass changes for now. @sriv can you help triage policy eval traces?

sriv: oncall here, joining. pulled logs: several panics referencing policy id=policy-routing-42, expression "request.region == \"eu-*\" && modelVariant.qps / 0 > 1" — looks like an invalid expression causing divide-by-zero in the evaluator. stack: `panic: runtime error: integer divide by zero` at policy.evaluator.go:214.

kai-eng: ugh that's the bad rewrite we pushed in canary earlier today. it was supposed to gate on `modelVariant.qps > 0` but got mangled. Canary applied to all regions due to route selector mismatch.

jess-oncall: important: panic in evaluator is causing policy engine to crash and trigger smart-routing fallback. The fallback logic currently prefers the cheapest compatible model variant; that led to routing into `gptx-small-unverified` which can't handle load -> cascade.

tess-eng: logs show a region fallback loop: when policy engine fails, router falls back to region fallback policy which reroutes to next region, policy tries to evaluate there, hits same panic, triggers further fallback. We have a loop across eu-west-1 -> eu-central-1 -> us-east-1.

ops-bot: Alert: 92% of requests to /v1/generate are experiencing 5xx or high latency in eu regions. Automatic mitigation attempted: scaled replicas + fallback routing.

maria-biz: flagged top customers on eu instances — 4 paying enterprise tenants seeing degraded responses. Need comms if ETA > 30m.

sriv: immediate mitigations I'd run: 1) disable policy-routing-42 to stop evaluator from loading the bad rule; 2) apply safe default routing policy that routes to pinned stable model variant (`gptx-stable-v2`) in-region; 3) restart policy-engine pods to clear crashed state.

jess-oncall: executing 1 and 3 now. posting commands:
```sh
# disable policy
redwoodctl policies disable policy-routing-42 --reason "panic in eval"
# restart policy engine pods
kubectl -n infra rollout restart deployment/policy-engine
```

kai-eng: I'm pushing a temporary runtime guard that catches expression exceptions and causes the evaluator to return an explicit non-match instead of panicking. patch preview: 
```go
func evalRule(r Rule) (bool, error) {
  defer func() {
    if r := recover(); r != nil {
      log.Errorf("policy eval panic: %v", r)
      // return safe false
    }
  }()
  return doEval(r)
}
```

sriv: +1 to the guard. we should not allow user expressions to crash the runtime. But for immediate customer impact we need the disable + route override.

jess-oncall: disable command returned OK. policy disabled at 14:20 UTC. rolling restart initiated.

ops-bot: Notice: policy-engine pods restarted at 14:22 UTC. Health checks passing but traffic to eu-west still high error rate.

tess-eng: routing override applied: wrote a temporary route policy that pins eu regions to `gptx-stable-v2` and forces no cross-region fallback. Command: 
```json
{"route_override": {"regions": ["eu-west-1","eu-central-1"], "model": "gptx-stable-v2", "allow_cross_region_fallback": false}}
```

sriv: good. now watching logs — evaluator no longer panicking because policy disabled. requests in eu now route to stable model but capacity got saturated; autoscaler is increasing dedicated pool.

kai-eng: also seeing a backlog in the small model queue from earlier fallbacks. recommend pausing traffic to `gptx-small-unverified` model pool and draining before re-enable.

jess-oncall: pausing small model pool now: `redwoodctl model disable gptx-small-unverified` — done.

maria-biz: relaying to CS: initial note sent to affected enterprise tenants. Will follow up with status update once we have steady error <1% or ETA.

team-sre: monitoring dashboards: error rate in eu down from 92% -> 15% since override, latency back to acceptable for pinned model but QPS still ~60% of baseline. Autoscaler expected to scale 15% more capacity in 10-15m.

jess-oncall: marking incident as "mitigated" for customer impact. continuing to monitor. Starting timeline notes for postmortem.

sriv: root cause summary so far: malformed rule expression (division by zero) deployed in canary accidentally promoted to global selector; policy evaluator panicked on user expression without recovery; fallback logic then pushed traffic into an unprepared model variant causing overload and cascading cross-region fallback loop.

kai-eng: next steps (short term): 1) add evaluator panic guard (hotfix) 2) add CI lint that checks for division/unsafe ops in rule DSL 3) tighten canary selector so canary updates don't apply globally by mistake 4) improve fallback policy to avoid cascading cross-region loops (max hop cap).

tess-eng: I'm drafting the hotfix PR and CI lint. Will attach to thread.

ops-bot: Note: scaling completed, eu capacity at 95% of required. Error rate now 0.9% (within SLO).

maria-biz: sending updated customer message: "We've mitigated routing error; service restored to >99% for most endpoints. We're investigating root cause and will send a detailed postmortem."

jess-oncall: handoff to @sriv for post-incident and postmortem. I will update incident tracker and set postmortem owner.

sriv: taking postmortem. setting owner. Estimated write-up ETA: EOD. Adding action items to backlog with priorities.

kai-eng: confirm PR with panic-guard and policy lint target: CR #3345. will request expedited review.

tess-eng: logging the rollout that caused issue: canary roll id=c-2026-03-15-09. Reverting any partial canary promotions and auditing rollout selectors.

jess-oncall: incident status -> Resolved (mitigated at 15:05 UTC, fully stable by 15:15 UTC). Reason: disabled bad policy + route override + model pool pause + autoscale.

team-sre: tagging for postmortem: severity=P1, impacted_regions=["eu-west-1","eu-central-1","us-east-1"], customers_impacted=4, duration=~1h03m.

maria-biz: follow-up: schedule customer calls for tomorrow 09:00 UTC with affected tenants.

sriv: closing notes: need permanent fixes before re-enabling smart routing: the evaluator needs safe execution boundary, policy DSL must forbid unsafe ops or be validated, and fallback logic needs circuit-breaker for cross-region reroutes.

jess-oncall: thanks all. please add any loose notes in the incident doc. I'll file the postmortem link once sriv publishes. :white_check_mark: 

incident-bot: Incident resolved and archived. Postmortem owner: sriv. Actions created: #457 (panic-guard hotfix), #458 (policy DSL lint), #459 (fallback-loop circuit-breaker).
